newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian senator denies plan to join Labor.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian senator denies plan to join Labor.

text.p: Key Australian Independent Senator Mal Colston will not rejoin the opposition Labor Party, from which he defected in August, his office said on Wednesday.
"There is no truth in the rumour," his spokeswoman said, reading from a statement from Colston.
He might make a formal statement later on Wednesday, she added.
Asked whether Colston was considering rejoining Labor, she said: "No, not at this stage."
The Sydney Morning Herald reported on Wednesday that Colston was considering an invitation from local Labor members in his Gold Coast base to return to the party.
The Liberal-National government may need Colston's support to get more than a quarter of its fiscal tightening legislation through parliament.

The government has announced measures that would save A$7.2 billion next fiscal year (from July), but about A$2 billion of that is in doubt in the upper house of parliament, the Senate, where the government is two votes short of a majority.
